see-where-a-spec-stands: Status reports the step, the status, the decisions and the next action

browse-specs: Expanding a spec lists its pipeline's documents, each with its own state
protect-the-run-record: A write merges into the record and never replaces it
A spec is never dragged backward

Two writers at once both land
record-a-run: Each spec folder holds one run record with a fixed core
History is a log of step and task boundaries
Step and status move together along one vocabulary
What the run decided, checked and worried about is kept beside the log
Timestamps say when the write happened
A capture finds its spec, or skips without failing the command
release-the-spec-kit-extension: A command file is built from its sources, never edited by hand
The release archive carries exactly the scripts the shipped commands reach for
The declared command list is the authority for what is installed and documented
The spec-kit extension releases under its own tag and a stable download address

expectations: No Converge button or menu entry
No Companion converge command or pipeline node
Converge appending tasks does not move the spec back from implemented
context: constraint: converge owns no status and never drags a spec backward
constraint: a step ends at its own first finish; waits billed to no phase
intent: Record Spec Kit converge runs in .spec-context.json and show them on the rail and in the Overview timing

decisions.decision: converge is a sub-phase of implement after implement in step order, owning no status
decisions.why: spec-kit runs it only after implement; owning implement statuses would drag implemented specs backward
decisions.rejected: a converging status of its own

decisions.decision: record converge via before_converge/after_converge hooks to two new companion capture commands
decisions.why: stock converge already fires both, so the extension stamps the real boundaries and the span is trusted
decisions.rejected: a preset override of the stock converge command

decisions.decision: currentStep moves to converge; lifecycleStepFor maps converge to implement for the reconciler, drift check, footer gates and reactivate
decisions.why: converge can only read in flight as the current step, and the repair pass would otherwise roll it back on every read

decisions.decision: Python STEP_ORDER gains converge but _is_more_advanced refuses it only at completed/archived
decisions.why: the consistency test mirrors STEP_NAMES, and the regression guard would otherwise refuse every converge write at implemented

decisions.decision: a trusted converge span after implement counts in the run total but not in timing coverage
decisions.why: converge is real work, while a run without it must still read fully timed

decisions.decision: Regenerate is hidden whenever converge is the current step
decisions.why: the user scoped out any way to start converge from the viewer; re-running it is starting it
decisions.rejected: re-running converge through a project-defined step

decisions.decision: reactivate on a converge spec moves currentStep back to implement
decisions.why: reactivate stamps a complete on the current step, which would otherwise re-close converge and stretch its span

decisions.decision: quiet thresholds, notifier labels and sort ranks became Maps
decisions.why: they are keyed by step text read from .spec-context.json, and an object literal answers prototype keys
decisions.rejected: adding a converge key to the object literals

decisions.decision: rank a converge currentStep as implement in the Python regression guard
decisions.why: with converge at 6, an implement start or advance after a mid-implement converge was refused and the spec could not reach implemented
decisions.rejected: ranking converge equal to implement in STEP_ORDER, which the consistency test pins to STEP_NAMES order

decisions.decision: status names the next open task once converge has run and the current step is implement or converge
decisions.why: a task close puts currentStep back on implement while the spec stays implemented
decisions.rejected: counting any converge entry regardless of step, which overrode disk reconciliation

concerns.note: The writer keeps one start and one finish per step, so only the first converge pass of an implement/converge loop is timed; later passes leave no trace and do not show in flight
Converge run while the spec is still implementing makes implement read as finished on the rail (the converge start closes implement), an off-label order spec-kit forbids
Mark Completed or Archive while converge is current sets the status without a history entry, so the sidebar last-activity time stays at the converge boundary
The quiet-run strip only appears for converge while the spec is implementing; a converge hung at implemented shows a running timer with no recovery strip
Doctor: 19 task finishes were journaled in bursts (worker appends folded in batches), so per-task durations are not trustworthy; history is append-only so this stays
